full_program_qualification.original_domain_flags: Original #560 cases 25 and 27 exceed pinned value bounds. All original cases and their outcomes remain preserved as compatibility diagnostics, not complete-domain proof.
full_program_qualification.scope: Both predecessors and successors in both languages; expected values remained outside the isolated runtimes; finite tests are not proof.

restricted_support_reference.scope: Exact only within three additive helper strings over the fixed observed-line basis and four qualified source assignments. Base lines are not pruned or relearned.

accounting.selection_payload_bits: selections multiplied by width; ten fewer six-bit selections saves 60 payload bits
accounting.input_packet: 41-byte header per program plus payload and final byte padding
accounting.dictionary_installation: LTD1 UTF-8 strings plus per-string length and dictionary framing; counted separately from interaction payload
accounting.package: dictionary installation plus both packets; common 8240-byte decoder separately reported
accounting.operands_and_helpers: All runtime argument syntax, helper definitions, punctuation and whitespace included in each full decoded source

interpretation.reason: Compare input, installation storage and readability separately. Package growth does not by itself reject the helper design. Readability/memorability has not been measured.
interpretation.no_break_even_claim: No installation/reuse frequency model, amortization break-even or human effort measurement was established.
interpretation.six_bit_successors: Joined helper saves ten selections and 60 payload bits versus line-only successors. Packet savings are 56 JavaScript / 64 Python bits due to padding; dictionary costs rise159 /202 bytes.
interpretation.finite_joint_reference: Across the frozen additive pool and four assignments, both predecessors with no added helper minimize measured input/package costs at each tested width. Other source/library candidates remain untested.

privacy: Aggregate counts, general helper definitions, rewrite spans and source/artifact hashes only. No full problem solution, original test body, claim token or ledger included.
